author: Gummy258
body:
I got banned a few months ago and I really learned my lesson because who would like to be unbanned from a server that has really fun minigames. Before i got banned this server was my favorite out of all my servers.Not only i have a lot of different servers but this is the only one that has CTW, CTF, and TDM.I've was liking the server but i got banned which mad me sad :(. so please unban me and u will relize that you did something that will heal some ones heart.


P.S. if you do unban me this will be my face :)-----GoldenCreeper258
